gui.aurelia.no_permission: You need MTR edit permission (creative or survival mode) to change transit data.

gui.aurelia.presets.title: Train presets
gui.aurelia.presets.name: Preset name
gui.aurelia.presets.pick_siding: Pick a siding on the left.
gui.aurelia.presets.no_sidings: No sidings. Open this from the MTR dashboard.
gui.aurelia.presets.applied: Applied "%s" to siding %s. Regenerate its depot if trains do not update.
gui.aurelia.presets.put.empty_name: Give the preset a name first.
gui.aurelia.presets.put.no_cars: This siding has no train to save.
gui.aurelia.presets.put.too_many_cars: Too many cars for one preset.
gui.aurelia.presets.put.library_full: Preset library is full (256). Delete one first.
gui.aurelia.presets.problem.mode: Not applied: preset is for %s, siding is %s.
gui.aurelia.presets.problem.length: Not applied: train is %s, siding rail is only %s.
gui.aurelia.stops.title: Route stop order
gui.aurelia.stops.pick_route: Pick a route on the left.
gui.aurelia.stops.hint: Drag stops to reorder (or select and Shift+Up/Down).
gui.aurelia.stops.no_routes: No routes. Open this from the MTR dashboard.
gui.aurelia.stops.changed_elsewhere: This route was changed elsewhere. Reloaded it; nothing was saved.
gui.aurelia.stops.saved: Saved. Regenerate depots so trains follow the new order.
gui.aurelia.stops.saved_no_depot: Saved. No depot runs this route yet.
gui.aurelia.dwell.title: Platform dwell times
gui.aurelia.dwell.pick_scope: Pick a scope on the left.
gui.aurelia.dwell.ticked: %s of %s ticked (click a row to toggle)
gui.aurelia.dwell.invalid: Dwell must be between 0.5 s and 10:00, in half seconds.
gui.aurelia.dwell.applied: %s platform(s) changed (%s). Regenerate depots so trains use the new times.
gui.aurelia.dwell.applied_no_depot: %s platform(s) changed (%s). No depot serves them yet.
gui.aurelia.overlap.title: Station overlaps
gui.aurelia.overlap.none: No platform is inside two station zones.
gui.aurelia.overlap.pick: Pick a platform on the left.
gui.aurelia.overlap.choose: Which station should it belong to?
gui.aurelia.overlap.will_change: Station zones that will be cut back:
gui.aurelia.overlap.not_reached: This would still not give it to that station.
gui.aurelia.overlap.impossible: Can't separate: a zone would shrink to nothing. Redraw the zones in MTR.
gui.aurelia.overlap.mismatch: Warning: %s platform(s) differ from ATU's reading of MTR's rule. Nothing is wrong in MTR; please report this.
gui.aurelia.height.title: Station and depot zone heights
gui.aurelia.height.pick: Pick a station (■) or depot (⌂) on the left.
gui.aurelia.height.invalid: Enter whole numbers, bottom not above top (blank = no limit).
gui.aurelia.depots.title: Depot health
gui.aurelia.depots.summary: %s depot(s), %s with problems. Pick one for details.
gui.aurelia.depots.healthy: Last generation succeeded and the setup looks right.
gui.aurelia.depots.deployed: Sent a train out of %s now.
gui.aurelia.depots.schedule_sent.save_we: Saved the departures %s has now as its weekday plan.
Saved the departures %s has now as its weekend plan.
gui.aurelia.depots.schedule_sent.cancel_: Cancelled the next run of %s. Departure screens show it as cancelled.
gui.aurelia.depots.regenerating: Regenerating %s depot(s). Press Refresh in a moment.
gui.aurelia.depots.problem.path_between: No path found between platform %s and platform %s. Check the rails connect in the route's direction and that trains can turn back where needed.
gui.aurelia.depots.problem.path_not_foun: No path found for its routes. Check the rails connect between all stops.
gui.aurelia.depots.problem.route_suspend: Route %s is suspended: its trains are held at the depot until the message expires.
gui.aurelia.depots.problem.no_sidings: Has no sidings inside its zone.
gui.aurelia.depots.problem.two_platforms: A route needs at least two platforms.
gui.aurelia.depots.problem.never_generat: Has never been generated (or MTR has no result yet).
gui.aurelia.depots.problem.unknown_statu: MTR reported a status ATU does not know.
gui.aurelia.depots.problem.sidings_faile: %s siding(s) could not reach the first platform.
gui.aurelia.depots.problem.sidings_witho: %s of %s siding(s) have no train selected.
gui.aurelia.depots.problem.route_too_sho: Route %s has fewer than two stops.
gui.aurelia.depots.problem.route_deleted: Route %s uses a platform that no longer exists.
gui.aurelia.codes.title: Station codes
gui.aurelia.codes.pick: Pick a route: its stations get numbered in route order.
gui.aurelia.codes.bad_numbers: Start and step are whole numbers (step not 0); digits 1 to 4.
gui.aurelia.codes.out_of_range: Numbers would go below 0 or above 9999.
gui.aurelia.departures.title: Departure times
gui.aurelia.departures.pick: Pick a depot on the left.
gui.aurelia.departures.invalid: Times as HH:MM, minutes as whole numbers (1 to 1440).
gui.aurelia.departures.shifted: Shifted all departures. Not saved yet.
gui.aurelia.departures.spaced: %s loop trains, one every %s. Not saved yet.
gui.aurelia.departures.hours_set: Hours %s to %s: one train every %s (MTR allows at most 5 an hour). Not saved yet.
gui.aurelia.departures.saved_timed: Saved %s timed departure(s). Regenerate the depot if trains do not follow.
gui.aurelia.departures.saved_hourly: Saved trains per hour. Regenerate the depot if trains do not follow.
gui.aurelia.departures.hours_cleared: Hours %s to %s: no trains. Not saved yet.
gui.aurelia.jump.title: Jump to a station, platform, depot or siding
gui.aurelia.jump.none: Nothing to jump to. Open this from the MTR dashboard.
gui.aurelia.jump.no_permission: Jumping uses /tp: you need operator rights or cheats on.
gui.aurelia.tools.melodies.tooltip: Tells Joban Client Mod vehicle scripts whether to play departure melodies. Scripts that do not read this setting ignore it.
gui.aurelia.tools.announcer.tooltip: Announces the next station, arrivals, changes and the last stop on MTR trains you ride. The lines go to chat and replace MTR's own chat announcement while you ride. Plays station clips (sound events mtr:aureliaex_ann_<key>) from a resource pack that provides them; without them it is text only.
gui.aurelia.tools.announcer.action_bar.t: Also shows the next stop, and the interchange or terminus, on the action bar when an announcement plays.
gui.aurelia.tools.announcer.wording.tool: Standard is the Announcer's own English. British follows the platform speakers' British style. Voice-pack clips stay the same either way.
gui.aurelia.presets.apply_depot.tooltip: Apply the preset to every siding of this siding's depot. Sidings it does not fit are skipped and named.
gui.aurelia.presets.settings.tooltip: Also save the siding's other settings with the train: acceleration, deceleration, max trains or manual driving, manual speed and the delay options. Applying such a preset sets them too.
gui.aurelia.presets.applied_depot: Applied "%s" to %s siding(s) in %s. Regenerate the depot if trains do not update.
gui.aurelia.presets.skipped: %s siding(s) skipped (too short or wrong type).
gui.aurelia.tools.platform.tooltip: When you stand on a platform, announces its next train in chat: about a minute before, while it arrives, and when it runs late. Uses the arrival times MTR's own departure screens show. Plays mtr:aureliaex_ann_platform_approaching / _arriving / _delayed from a resource pack that has them, otherwise a chime.
gui.aurelia.return.title: Return route
gui.aurelia.return.name: Name of the new route
gui.aurelia.return.pick_route: Pick the route to build the return of.
gui.aurelia.return.deleted_platform: This route stops at a platform that no longer exists. Fix it in MTR first.
gui.aurelia.return.created: Created "%s" with %s stops. Add it to a depot to run trains on it.
gui.aurelia.return.created_depots: Created "%s" with %s stops and added it to %s depot(s). Regenerate them so trains run it.
gui.aurelia.return.help: Stops run in reverse. Green stops moved to the other platform of their station; the ends keep theirs. Pick a stop and press Other platform to change it. Same colour, number and type as the original.
gui.aurelia.control.title: Route control
gui.aurelia.control.pick_route: Pick a route on the left.
gui.aurelia.control.fallback_on: Saved. Taken planned platforms fall back to a free one.
gui.aurelia.control.fallback_off: Saved. Trains always use the planned platforms.
gui.aurelia.control.fallback_hint: Turn on fallback so a taken planned platform uses a free one.
gui.aurelia.control.master_off: Fallback is off on the panel, so no route resolves one.
gui.aurelia.control.master.tooltip: Master switch: off means no route falls back to a free platform, whatever each route says.
gui.aurelia.control.stops: Stops — pick one, then Platform cycles its station's platforms:
gui.aurelia.control.no_rail: No rail within %s blocks of you.
gui.aurelia.control.help: Waypoints are rail points the route must pass, in order: type block coordinates, or stand by a rail and press At rail. Each waypoint follows the picked stop (or the last one). Platform shows the stop's choice, cycling its station's platforms; cycling back to the planned one clears the choice. Changes save at once.
gui.aurelia.speed.title: Speed check
gui.aurelia.speed.summary: %s rail(s) within render distance: %s slow spot(s), %s fast curve(s). Only rails near you are checked: MTR sends no others to your game.
gui.aurelia.speed.slow_detail: Slow spot: this rail allows %s km/h while the rails on both ends allow at least %s km/h. Trains brake for it every time. Usually one segment laid with the wrong rail type: replace it with MTR's rail tools.
gui.aurelia.speed.curve_detail: Fast curve: radius %s m at %s km/h. About %s km/h is comfortable for that radius on a real line. MTR does not slow trains for curves, so this is only advice.
gui.aurelia.speed.clean: No slow spots and no fast curves among the rails around you.
gui.aurelia.speed.no_rails: No rails near you. Stand near the line you want to check.
gui.aurelia.speed.help: Pick a finding for details. Jump takes you to it.
gui.aurelia.trains.title: Train inspector
gui.aurelia.depots.problem.no_departures: Has no departures: the timed list is empty, or every hour is set to no trains. No train will ever leave.
gui.aurelia.depots.problem.siding_isolat: Siding %s has no track leading out of it, so its trains cannot reach the route. (Checked for sidings within render distance only.)
gui.aurelia.depots.problem.platform_no_s: Stops at %s, which is in no station zone: departure screens and announcements show nothing there.
gui.aurelia.panel.title: Aurelia panel
gui.aurelia.pantograph.animation.tooltip: Off keeps every pantograph lowered, as modelled
gui.aurelia.pantograph.end.tooltip: Which end rises for parts that do not choose one, relative to the direction of travel
gui.aurelia.architecture.studio.tooltip: Opens Station Studio in your browser
gui.aurelia.architecture.station.tooltip: Plan or build the station on the wrench in your hand
gui.aurelia.architecture.station.hold: Hold an ATR wrench to use this
gui.aurelia.architecture.airport.tooltip: Plan or build the airport on the wrench in your hand
gui.aurelia.architecture.airport.hold: Hold an ATR wrench to use this
gui.aurelia.architecture.bridge.tooltip: Save a bridge you built, then lay it along any rail, from the wrench in your hand
gui.aurelia.architecture.bridge.hold: Hold an ATR wrench to use this
gui.aurelia.architecture.earthworks.tool: Level, slopes, retaining walls, tunnels and viaducts
gui.aurelia.architecture.earthworks.hold: Hold an ATR wrench to use this
gui.aurelia.architecture.hologram.toolti: See-through copies of the planned blocks, drawn only to you
gui.aurelia.architecture.hologram.fallba: Uses the old particle outline instead of the hologram, for slow PCs
gui.aurelia.architecture.hologram.more.t: Red tint and a one-level layer slider
gui.aurelia.architecture.hologram.tint.t: Marks planned blocks that would replace a block already standing there
Shows only one height of the plan; scroll the slider to All for the whole station
gui.aurelia.builder.hold: Hold a Rail Builder to change it
gui.aurelia.riding.sit.tooltip: Each ride starts sitting or standing. The sit key (X by default) switches while you ride.
gui.aurelia.train_sound.wide_pitch.toolt: Vanilla limits every sound to pitch 0.5-2. On: train sounds go from 0.25 up to the maximum below, so BVE motor tables play as written.
Old-style (non-BVE) trains jump between motor clips at each speed step. This bends the pitch across a step so the jump is smaller.
gui.aurelia.train_sound.door_chime.toolt: Plays once on every train as its doors start to close.
gui.aurelia.train_sound.profile.tooltip: Applies to the train you are riding, or the nearest train. Cycles through the profiles loaded from resource packs; None uses the train default below when there is one, else the train's own sound. Your pick always wins over the default.
gui.aurelia.train_sound.default.tooltip: The default profile this train's pack names with an aurelia_sound tag. It plays only while your pick above is None and Use train defaults is on.
gui.aurelia.train_sound.use_defaults.too: When on, a train whose pack names a default profile uses it unless you pick one above. Your pick always wins.
gui.aurelia.panel.pack.enabled.tooltip: Reads assets/<namespace>/aurelia_packs/*.json from resource packs and data/<namespace>/aurelia_packs/*.json from data packs. Off turns the loader off until it is switched back on.
gui.aurelia.panel.pack.example.tooltip: The built-in example private pack with made-up names. Off by default.
gui.aurelia.panel.pack.counts: %s operators, %s liveries, %s sounds, %s station presets, %s timetables
gui.aurelia.panel.pack.none: No packs found. Add assets/<namespace>/aurelia_packs/<name>.json to a resource pack.
gui.aurelia.look.hint: On uses the Aurelia look. Off puts that screen back to MTR's widgets.
gui.aurelia.menu.title: Aurelia Transit Railway
gui.aurelia.menu.subtitle.build: Pick a wrench mode, or open Station Studio
gui.aurelia.menu.subtitle.guide: How stations, signs and the Codex work
gui.aurelia.menu.subtitle.settings: Your own switches; server rules are in the panel
gui.aurelia.menu.subtitle.dev: The full Aurelia panel and its tabs
gui.aurelia.menu.build.station.tooltip: Open the wrench in Station mode
gui.aurelia.menu.build.airport.tooltip: Open the wrench in Airport mode
gui.aurelia.menu.build.bridge.tooltip: Open the wrench in Bridge mode
gui.aurelia.menu.build.earthworks.toolti: Open the wrench in Earthworks mode
gui.aurelia.menu.build.studio.tooltip: Open the browser Studio: long descriptions, a 3D preview and every check
gui.aurelia.menu.build.wayfinding.toolti: Open the Codex chapter on signs, gates and platform colours
gui.aurelia.menu.build.give.tooltip: Operators only: puts one ATR wrench in your inventory
gui.aurelia.menu.build.hold: Hold an ATR wrench to open a mode
gui.aurelia.menu.build.no_wrench: Hold the ATR wrench (or an old station/airport wrench) to open a build mode.
gui.aurelia.menu.settings.action_bar.too: Show the new mode on the action bar when the wheel or V switches it
gui.aurelia.passengers.tooltip: Passengers appear on platforms, board trains going to their station and get off there. They are plain records on the server, not mobs. Off by default.
gui.aurelia.passengers.cost: Server cost: %s ms per update (once a second)
gui.aurelia.passengers.operators: Only operators can change the caps above
gui.aurelia.passengers.draw.tooltip: Figures for people waiting on platforms and riding in cars. Off by default, so shader packs and low-end PCs draw nothing until this is on. Blue is waiting, orange is riding.
gui.aurelia.passengers.draw_distance.too: Nothing is drawn past this. Lower it to cut the per-frame draw cost.
gui.aurelia.passengers.detail_distance.t: People are full player figures inside this; between here and the simple distance one cheap figure stands for the crowd.
gui.aurelia.passengers.max_drawn.tooltip: The most figures drawn at one platform or train. Lower it to cut the per-frame draw cost.
gui.aurelia.passengers.max_walkers.toolt: The most walkers drawn at once. Each full walker is a player model; lower it to cut the per-frame draw cost.
gui.aurelia.passengers.draw_cost: Draw cost: %s ms per frame, %s walkers, %s figures
gui.aurelia.passengers.draw_cost.off: Draw cost: off (passenger drawing is off)
gui.aurelia.passengers.routes.tooltip: People walk round what is built and use stairs, escalators and lifts. Off, they walk straight to the doors and new people just appear, and no blocks are scanned.
gui.aurelia.map.title: Map
gui.aurelia.map.scan.tooltip: How fast the map fills in. Higher reads more of the world each tick and costs more frame time.
gui.aurelia.map.hint: Drag to move, scroll to zoom, C to centre on you
gui.aurelia.zip.operators: Only operators can change zip lines
gui.aurelia.build.operators: Only operators can change the building tools
gui.aurelia.vehicles.operators: Only operators can change road vehicles
gui.aurelia.driving.aws.tooltip: Horn at a caution or danger signal, bell at a clear one. Not acknowledged in time, a service brake applies.
gui.aurelia.driving.tpws.tooltip: Emergency brake on overspeed or passing a signal at danger. Reset with the AWS/TPWS key once stopped.
gui.aurelia.driving.score.tooltip: Shows stop accuracy, time, SPADs and overspeeds for each run
gui.aurelia.driving.stop_marker.tooltip: Draws the yellow stop board beside the track at the next platform stop
gui.aurelia.driving.aws_time.tooltip: How long AWS waits for the cancellation button before applying the brake
gui.aurelia.driving.hud_size.tooltip: Scale of the driver's cab HUD
key.aurelia.crew.signal: Crew signal (bell, right away, hold signal)
gui.aurelia.crew.role.tooltip: Your job on the railway. Guard: ring ready to start for your train. Dispatcher: give right away to trains at the platform. Signaller: hold signals at danger. The crew key (G) does the job.
gui.aurelia.crew.role.driver.how: Drive with a driver key; wait for your crew's signal before leaving a platform.
gui.aurelia.crew.role.guard.how: Ride the train; once the doors are shut, press the crew key to ring ready to start.
gui.aurelia.crew.role.dispatcher.how: Stand on the platform; press the crew key to give right away to the trains standing there.
gui.aurelia.crew.role.signaller.how: Look at a signal and press the crew key to hold it at danger; press again to release.
gui.aurelia.crew.role.unknown: No such role: try guard, dispatcher, signaller, driver or none.
gui.aurelia.crew.pick_role: Pick a crew role first: Aurelia panel > Driving, or /atr_crew role
gui.aurelia.crew.not_on_train: Ride the train first to ring for it.
gui.aurelia.crew.doors_open: Doors still open: ring once they are shut.
gui.aurelia.crew.rang_nobody: Nobody near enough to hear it.
gui.aurelia.crew.hold.look: Look at a signal to hold or release it.
gui.aurelia.crew.hold.no_signal: No signal there, or too far away.
gui.aurelia.driving.tpws.stop: TPWS trip: stop, then press TPWS reset
